description: This file defines extension methods for IServiceCollection to set up dependency injection for a Notes application. It includes methods to configure database context, repositories, services, JWT authentication, and Swagger with JWT support.

classes.name: ServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure dependency injection, authentication, and Swagger for the application.

methods.name: AddAppDb
methods.description: Configures the application's database context to use an in-memory database for development.

methods.name: AddRepositories
methods.description: Registers repository implementations for user and note data access.

methods.name: AddAppServices
methods.description: Registers application services like token, user, and note services.

methods.name: AddJwtAuth
methods.description: Sets up JWT bearer authentication using configured settings, including issuer, audience, and secret key.

methods.name: AddSwaggerWithJwt
methods.description: Configures Swagger to include API documentation and JWT Bearer authentication support.
